snippet.title: The Artifactory - Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
The Artifactory is a chaotic couch co-op party game set in a whimsical fantasy lootbox factory! Craft potions, forge weapons, and experiment with recipes to fulfill unpredictable orders. Fix broken machines, survive moving platforms, lava, and more! Play solo or with up to 4 players!

WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511520/The_Artifactory
